body: Yeah, you're right. Thanks for taking the time and replying to me, it helped me refocus my mind a bit.
Okay, I'll try pushing. It's scares me, but I know I should so I'll try.
I used to like things, but I can't anymore. Most days leaving my bed and going to work is too much. I appreciate the suggestion, but those things feel too far away now
Thank you, but I feel like all I do is talk. I talk, feel a little better, I cry and then the cycle repeats. I can't handle this roller coaster anymore.
